ownerBio:
My name is Peter Gong. I've been in comic book retail for thirty plus years. I've been an avid comic book collector for even more years. But I emphasize the point of reading rather than collecting, and like to refer to myself as "comic-sama."

My personal tastes vary from the esoteric to the popular. I'm also a serious anime and manga fan, going back to the 70s classic stuff to some current series and movies. I also love all genre films in general.
storeDescription: My store is friendly and laid back, offering a welcome mat to all who embrace all facets of fandom. Phoenix Comics & Collectibles of Long Island is a haven for the genre connoisseur!
tagline: Your Long Island haven for comics, manga, sci-fi novels, and collectibles.
